stages.title: Intake and contract review
stages.purpose: Decide whether the laboratory may and can take the work, on terms both sides understand. Nothing technical starts until this stage closes.

gate.statement: CR-2026-XXX exists, Decision = Accept, and the written Authorization to Test is filed in 00_Contract. Without all three, no technical work begins.

steps.title: Register and screen the request
steps.guidance: Log the request before any technical discussion, so the review has a start date and a reference. Anything outside SC-LAB-01 is excluded or subcontracted — it cannot be absorbed.
requirements: Request logged with date received, client, contact and the client's own reference; request document saved to 00_Contract
Scope checked against SC-LAB-01: out-of-scope items excluded, or subcontracting agreed with the client's written approval (PR-EXT-01)

steps.title: Impartiality, confidentiality and capability
steps.guidance: Ask specifically whether the laboratory or any assigned person designed, consulted on, sold or previously certified this DUT or its firmware. Check calibration against the planned job end, not today.
requirements: FR-COI-02 completed with prior involvement in this DUT, its firmware or the vendor explicitly checked; any risk recorded in RG-RSK-01 with its mitigation, or the work declined
FR-CONF-02 and FR-CONF-01 on file; authorized person in RG-CMP-01, equipment in RG-EQP-01 valid past the planned job end, and the required method all confirmed available

steps.title: Contract, decision rule and authorization to test
steps.guidance: Ambiguity written here is the single largest cause of dispute later. For security testing the authorization letter is what makes the testing lawful and bounded.
requirements: CHK-CTR-01 completed in full; DUT, versions, services, interfaces in and out of scope, environment, dates and deliverables documented; decision rule and statement-of-conformity basis agreed in writing (ISO 7.1.3)

Written Authorization to Test on file stating rules of engagement, interfaces and IP ranges, test window, whether destructive testing is permitted, data handling and escalation contact — and CR-2026-XXX logged with Decision = Accept

stages.title: Job setup and readiness
stages.purpose: Turn an accepted contract into a controlled job with people, equipment, item and records ready before anyone touches the device.

gate.statement: JOB-2026-XXX is open, the job file exists, roles are authorized, the item and equipment are recorded as fit, and the three job documents exist with a version.

steps.title: Open the job and the job file
steps.guidance: The Job_Register row is the spine everything else hangs from.
requirements: JOB-2026-XXX created in Process_Control > Job_Register, linked to the CR ID, with Responsible Engineer, Technical Reviewer and Authorized Signatory named and dates set
Job folder created to the PR-TR-01 structure (00_Contract … 06_NC_Complaints) and its path recorded

steps.title: People, item, equipment and environment
steps.guidance: Competence is not a job title — it is the authority flags in RG-CMP-01 against the methods this job uses. Record the item as it actually arrived, including anything wrong with it.
requirements: Each role holder Active in RG-CMP-01 with the right authority flag and the methods authorized; the Technical Reviewer is not the tester, or the deputy / external reviewer is recorded
FR-ITEM-01A completed with photographs, condition and any abnormality; client consulted if the item is unsuitable; item in controlled, segregated storage
Equipment In Service with Next Due Date past the planned job end and fitness confirmed; bench, isolated test network (PR-ENV-01) and least-privilege job access (RG-ACC-01) in place

steps.title: Create the job document set
steps.guidance: One set per DUT and project, each file from its controlled template. Never reuse another job's copies.
requirements: Workflow tracker, IXIT & DUT Identification (placed in Test Report › [03] Forms) and Method / Test Mapping copied from controlled templates, versioned under PR-DOC-01, recorded in 01 Job Record; kick-off held on scope, roles, safety, confidentiality and evidence naming

stages.title: DUT identification and the ICS
stages.purpose: Fix exactly what is being assessed, and establish which ETSI provisions apply to it. Every ICS Support value switches methods on or off — an ICS accepted without challenge produces a conformity statement resting on an unverified claim.

gate.statement: Every conditional method carries an ICS Support value, every one of the 63 methods carries an applicability decision with its basis, and every N has been challenged and accepted by the laboratory.

steps.title: Identify the DUT
steps.guidance: §2 of the IXIT document is the unambiguous identification ISO 7.8.2 will require in the report. The constrained-device answer alone changes the applicability of several provisions.
requirements: IXIT document §1 document control complete (standard, test specification, scope, methodology, project ID, prepared and reviewed by, classification, version, date); file named for the job in Test Report › [03] Forms

§2 complete: manufacturer, model, hardware revision, serial, MAC, firmware as received and at end of assessment, interfaces, management address, default credential source, companion app, supplied material — anything not supplied marked “Not provided” with the reason, never left blank

steps.title: Obtain and challenge the ICS
steps.guidance: This is an assessment activity, not an inbox task. Challenge anything the device's own description contradicts.
requirements: ICS Support (G) returned Y / N / N-A for every method whose Conditions column states a condition, attributable to who declared it and when
Applicable? (H) set for all 63 methods with its basis in (I); every N and N-A challenged against its condition and against §2; clarifications logged in tracker 06C and closed

stages.title: IXIT completion and adequacy review
stages.purpose: Collect the implementation detail the methods need, and confirm it is good enough to assess against. One entry per real thing — a single-entry IXIT silently collapses the assessment into one untraceable test.

gate.statement: Every IXIT entry named by an applicable method is present at entry-per-mechanism granularity, with its information source recorded, and the IXIT document is approved at an issue version.

steps.title: Collect the IXIT
steps.guidance: Reject records that say “all interfaces are secured”. Every mechanism, component, interface, parameter and service gets its own row and its own ID. IXIT 1–29 are filled in the job copy of IXIT_and_DUT_Identification_Template.docx, in Test Report › [03] Forms.
requirements: Required IXIT tables identified from Required IXIT Entries (R) across every method with Applicable = Y

IXIT 1–29 completed in the job copy: one entry per mechanism keeping its template ID, information source recorded per entry, unused template rows deleted, and dependencies cross-referenced by ID (AuthMech → SecParam, ComMech → NetSecImpl, SoftServ → Intf, UpdMech → UpdProc)

steps.title: Adequacy review and approval
steps.guidance: Adequacy observations are part of the assessment record and may be reported. Missing information is an information gap — it is never an N/A.
requirements: Every entry checked against the fields column R asks for; entries that are vague, inconsistent or contradict §2 recorded in tracker 06C with their effect on the verdict

Consolidated clarification issued with owner and due date, responses re-reviewed and the gap rows closed; no required entry left empty; IXIT document approved at an issue version and recorded in tracker 04A

stages.title: Method selection and the test plan
stages.purpose: Confirm the applicable methods are valid for this DUT, settle deviations in advance, and plan the work before anyone touches the device.

gate.statement: Applicability is complete for all 63 methods, verification or validation records exist for every method in use, deviations are authorized, and the Technical Reviewer has approved the plan.

steps.title: Confirm the methods and settle deviations
steps.guidance: Methods are controlled documents — never edit a method's steps or acceptance criteria inside a job copy. A deviation authorized after the fact is a nonconformity, not a deviation.
requirements: Job copy taken from the current controlled mapping revision, with columns A–F, J, K, P and R untouched
Verification evidence on first use for standard methods; modified or laboratory-developed methods validated and authorized under PR-MET-01, with the record in 05_Review_QC before use
Every applicable method has the IXIT entries column R names present and adequate; any departure from a method authorized in advance in tracker 06A with its justification and its effect on the verdict

steps.title: Plan the work and approve it
steps.guidance: Testing does not start on a draft plan.
requirements: Test plan written: tester per method, equipment IDs, setup and network topology, schedule, evidence to capture and its naming convention, QC checks planned in tracker 06B with an acceptance criterion each, and the safety and destructive-testing constraints from the Authorization to Test
Plan approved by the Technical Reviewer and recorded with name and date in 01 Job Record

stages.title: Assessment execution and evidence
stages.purpose: Perform the assessment and produce records another competent person could re-create the result from. Work the loop: for each method with Applicable = Y, conceptual assessment first, then functional.

gate.statement: Every applicable method has a tester verdict, every verdict names at least one registered Evidence ID, every evidence file is registered once with a hash, and planned QC is logged.

steps.title: Baseline the DUT and assess conceptually
steps.guidance: Every later observation is relative to the baseline, so capture it before you start. Write the reasoning, not just the conclusion.
requirements: DUT baseline set and captured as evidence: factory reset or documented configuration, firmware version, network topology

Conceptual assessment of the IXIT entries in column R against the acceptance criteria in column K, with the reasoning written in Tester Notes (S); insufficient information recorded as a gap in tracker 06C

steps.title: Test the DUT and register the evidence
steps.guidance: An unrecorded deviation invalidates the result. Register each file once — never twice under two Evidence IDs, and never cite an unregistered artefact.
requirements: Functional assessment executed in the controlled setup using only RG-EQP-01 equipment, with the IDs actually used recorded in tracker 03; any unplanned deviation authorized in 06A, or work stopped and NC-2026-XXX raised, before continuing

Each evidence file registered once in tracker 05 with ID, type, description, location, SHA-256, date, collector, related method and IXIT IDs, confidentiality and retention; stored in 03_Evidence under its Evidence ID

steps.title: Set the verdicts and run quality control
steps.guidance: The verdict comes from the acceptance criteria, not from impression. N-A traces to a declaration, never to missing information.
requirements: Verdict (Tester) (L) set for every method with Applicable = Y, taken strictly from column K, with Evidence ID(s) (O) populated; N-A used only where it traces to the ICS, INCONCLUSIVE where information is missing and testing cannot resolve it
Planned QC performed under PR-QC-01 and logged in tracker 06B and Process_Control > QC_Activities; verdict counts entered per provision group in tracker 04B

stages.title: Technical review
stages.purpose: Confirm independently that the records support the verdicts, before anything is reported. The reviewer did not perform the work.

gate.statement: Every tested method carries a reviewer verdict and a Final Verdict, the tracker counts reconcile, and the reviewer has signed the review record in 05_Review_QC.

steps.title: Confirm independence and completeness
requirements: Reviewer did not perform the work under review and holds Can Perform Technical Review = Yes in RG-CMP-01
Every method with Applicable = Y carries a tester verdict; every Applicable = N has a basis in (I) that matches the ICS declaration in (G)

steps.title: Check traceability and correctness, then sign
steps.guidance: Traceability is what an assessor will test hardest: can any single verdict be followed back to a file with a hash? The Final Verdict column is what the report reproduces.
requirements: Every tested method names an Evidence ID that exists in tracker 05; every file in 03_Evidence is registered with a matching SHA-256; every IXIT entry a verdict rests on is in the approved IXIT document

No PASS the recorded evidence does not support; every deviation authorized in advance; every INCONCLUSIVE states what was missing and what would resolve it; equipment calibration valid on the test date; planned QC performed

Verdict (Reviewer) (M) and Final Verdict (N) set for every tested method, anything not accepted returned and re-reviewed; tracker 04 reconciliation reads OK; review record signed and stored in 05_Review_QC

stages.title: Reporting
stages.purpose: Report the results accurately, clearly and unambiguously, with a conformity statement that rests on the agreed decision rule.

gate.statement: The report is signed by an Authorized Signatory, logged as REP-2026-XXX, and issued with the transmittal recorded.

steps.title: Draft the report
steps.guidance: ISO 7.8.2 content is not negotiable, and a reader must be able to see what was not tested and why.
requirements: ISO 7.8.2 content present: laboratory identity and where the work was performed, client, unambiguous item identification with hardware and firmware versions, dates of receipt and of testing, methods and any deviations or exclusions, results, the person authorizing the report, and the statement that results relate only to the items tested

Results reported per provision with verdict, method applied and basis; Not Applicable provisions shown with their ICS justification; INCONCLUSIVE verdicts and material IXIT observations carried forward

Decision rule applied and stated with the risk it accepts; the scope of the conformity statement stated; opinions and interpretations marked as such and issued only by authorized personnel; any subcontracted result and its provider identified

steps.title: Finalize, approve and issue
requirements: Every {{...}} placeholder replaced, Annex T deleted, §4 counts and figures taken from tracker 04, and TLP and classification consistent on the cover, in the header and in the footer

Checked against the reviewed records and signed by the Authorized Signatory; REP-2026-XXX logged in Process_Control > Reports_Index; issued through the agreed channel with the transmittal recorded in 04_Report

stages.title: Closure
stages.purpose: Return the item, secure the records, learn from the job and close it formally.

gate.statement: Item disposed of as agreed, job file archived with retention applied, access revoked, Job_Register Status = Done.

steps.title: Deal with the item and archive the records
requirements: Item returned, retained or disposed of exactly as agreed with action, date and recipient recorded; device restored or securely wiped where firmware or credentials were modified during testing

Job file complete — IXIT document, mapping, tracker, test plan, evidence, review record, signed report and transmittal — archived under PR-REC-CTRL-01 with the retention period applied and the backup verified

steps.title: Close down access and close the job
requirements: Job-specific access rights revoked in RG-ACC-01 and recorded; client data held outside the archive securely deleted
Client feedback requested and recorded, lessons fed into RG-RSK-01 and PR-MRV-01, and Job_Register Status = Done with the End Date

stages.title: Nonconforming work
stages.purpose: Contain work that does not conform to this procedure or to the client's requirements, and decide what happens to the results. Can be triggered at any point in the job.

gate.statement: The decision on affected work is recorded, the client has been informed where a report was affected, resumption is authorized in writing, and the NC is closed with an outcome.

steps.title: Contain and decide
requirements: NC-2026-XXX recorded in Process_Control > NC_Work_Log with its significance, the immediate action taken and the affected work held
Decision on the affected work taken and recorded; client informed and any issued report recalled or amended where it was affected

steps.title: Resume and correct
requirements: Resumption of work authorized in writing; corrective action raised under PR-CAP-01 where the nonconformity recurs or could recur, its reference recorded, and the NC closed with an outcome

stages.title: Complaints
stages.purpose: Handle a complaint about the laboratory's activities, with the investigation and the decision taken by people who were not involved in the work complained of.

gate.statement: The outcome is decided by person(s) not involved in the original activity, communicated formally to the complainant, and the complaint is closed.

steps.title: Receive and validate
steps.guidance: Gathering and verifying the information needed to validate the complaint is the laboratory's responsibility, not the complainant's.
requirements: CMP-2026-XXX logged in Process_Control > Complaints_Log and receipt acknowledged; confirmed whether it relates to laboratory activities the lab is responsible for, with out-of-scope complaints closed in writing with an explanation

steps.title: Investigate, decide and close
requirements: Investigated by someone not involved in the original work (ISO 7.9.5); job file, tracker, mapping, IXIT document, evidence, review record and report examined; NC-2026-XXX raised where nonconforming work is confirmed
Decision made, reviewed and approved by person(s) not involved in the original activity (ISO 7.9.6); outcome and formal notice of closure communicated to the complainant and recorded
